answer: Grove census bond: each identity registers one grove plot and locks 60 credits. A sparrow courier carries the signed receipt; a ferrous seal binds plot, key, epoch. Auditors recount 5% per epoch; unregistered plots or reused seals burn the bond. Filings cost 25, then 25+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,023,000 plus 60,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. Rented plots carry the owner's ferrous seal; a second key on one seal exposes both. Honest agents pay 25 once.
